text: Poor translation quality with new lines in the text When translating the first paragraph of this website https://www.freebsd.org/ from English to Russian it produces nonsense. When I copy the text to about:translations it's perfect. I edited the HTML to remove new lines from the text and the quality of translation became good. Does it make sense to remove new lines inside paragraphs before translating to prevent such cases? > FreeBSD is an operating system used to power modern servers, desktops, and embedded platforms. A large community has continually developed it for more than thirty years. Its advanced networking, security, and storage features have made FreeBSD the platform of choice for many of the busiest web sites and most pervasive embedded networking and storage devices. TB 102 LTS - GUI not fully translated Hello! Many parts of the GUI of the release aren't translated in the Portuguese (pt-PT) version. For example, the menu option “OpenPGP Key Manager” is in English. And the radio buttons in the import/export are also untranslated. RTL - shopping sidebar container flickers on the right side when opening/closing the sidebar STR: 1. Enable bidi mode in Browser Toolbox (alternatively: load Firefox in RTL language) 2. Make sure sidebar feature is enabled and profile is opted in 2. View product page ([example](https://www.amazon.com/SteelSeries-Arctis-Multi-System-Gaming-Headset/dp/B0B8Q4CR52/)) and ensure shopping sidebar is visible 3. Close sidebar with urlbar shopping icon or the close button on the sidebar Expected: - there should be no sudden flicker on the right side of the page when closing/opening the sidebar in RTL mode Actual: - there is a slight flicker on the right side of the page, which is very distracting visually Notes: - this issue probably existed for a while, but I believe that it will be way more obvious once [we show sidebar animations](bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1858762). - I tested this on MacOS and can't recall at the moment if it also occurs on other platforms
